Accounts, Create a Fighter, New Fighters and Languages — semantic diff

Branch feature/accounts-fighters-and-languagesBase 7c6b910Head fa93c3a Target mainDate 2026-11-13 Commits 14Files 79 · +5826 / −362 Written by REVIEW: · Claude Opus 5.5

Summary

  • Up to 5 accounts per device, each with its own progress and language; old progress becomes "Player 1".
  • Settings: language (English, Deutsch, Schwiizerdütsch, Español, Italiano) and a reset of coins and trophies.
  • Create a fighter: one per account, unlocked only by the new code CREATOR, playable with friends.
  • 5 new fighters (Marina free) with richer 3D models, and 3 more skins for every fighter (45).
  • The QR print page asks for the password M6D2.

Recommendation: Approve with follow-ups — all automated checks pass (pytest 38, Vitest 226, svelte-check 0); the visual checks of the new fighters, skins and screens are still open.

Spec context

2026_11_13_accounts_fighters_and_languages_spec.md — statements S1–S24; Steps 1–11 (issue #15).

Semantic diff

Why: Mattia and his friends share one device and want their own progress, a fighter they design themselves, more and nicer fighters and skins, and the game in their own language. Parents want to start over and to keep the printed QR codes away from the kids. Before this branch a device had one progress, ten fighters, one or two skins each and English only.

Breaking: none — saved progress is migrated (the old key is kept), the API only adds fighters, skins and a hack, and a room member without the new field is read as before. · Checks: 7 pass · 2 n/a · 0 fail

Author Q&A

Does progress saved before this version survive?
Yes. The first start copies hack-star.progress (version 2 or 3) into account "Player 1" and leaves the old key, so going back to the previous version also works.
Why does the created fighter's look travel in the skin id?
Pictures, the 3D stage, the arena and room members already pass a skin id (max 20 characters). A 16-character code ("L" + type + head + body + 2 colours) made them work unchanged; only the name is sent separately to friends.
Is the QR password secure?
No, on purpose: it is checked in the browser and is in the public code; it keeps kids from printing the codes (agreed in Part 1).
Why are the 45 new skins recolours with one extra part?
One generic way (skins3d.ts) for 15 fighters instead of 45 hand-made looks; a test checks every skin has other colours and more parts. The looks still need a visual check.

4 · The created look travels in the skin id

ui/src/lib/created.ts:16-27 · 0a0aa1d · Step 7 · D8 (changed)

16/**
17 * The look travels as the fighter's skin id ("L" + type + head + body + two colours, 16
18 * characters), so the 3D models, pictures and rooms work without knowing about it.
19 */
20export function lookSkin(look: Look): string {
21 return `L${FIGHTER_TYPE_IDSIndex encoding — The type is stored as its position 0–4 in a fixed list, so the code stays short and order changes would be a breaking change..indexOf(look.type)}${look.head}${look.body}${look.main.slice(1)}${look.second.slice(1)}`
22}
23
24export function parseLookSkin(skin: string): Look | null {
25 const m = /^L([0-4])([0-2])([0-2])([0-9a-f]{6})([0-9a-f]{6})$/i.execRegExp.exec — Returns the captured groups or null; the anchors ^…$ make sure the whole skin id is a look, not just part of it.(skin)
26 if (!m) return null
27 return { type: FIGHTER_TYPE_IDS[Number(m[1])], head: Number(m[2]), body: Number(m[3]), main: `#${m[4]}`, second: `#${m[5]}` }

What changed: A 16-character code "L" + type + head + body + two colours, and its parser. Why it matters: Pictures, 3D stage, arena and room members already carry a skin id (max 20 characters), so they work unchanged. Check: The regex accepts only valid looks; anything else falls back to a default look in the 3D builder.

8 · New skins: recolour plus one extra part

ui/src/lib/models/skins3d.ts:45-54 · ccb1b92 · Step 10 · D14 (changed), S14

46function recolour(rig: Rig, [h, s, l]: Variant['hsl']) {
47 rig.root.traverse((o) => {
48 if (!(o instanceof THREE.Mesh) || o.material === OUTLINE) return
49 const material = (o.material as THREE.Material).cloneMaterial.clone — Builders may share a material between parts; cloning lets the skin change colours without touching other rigs.() as THREE.MeshStandardMaterial
50 material.color?.offsetHSLColor.offsetHSL — Three.js shifts a colour in HSL space; one hue offset recolours a whole fighter while keeping its light and dark parts.(h, s, l)

What changed: Each mesh material is cloned and its colour shifted in hue, saturation and lightness; then an accessory is added. Why it matters: 45 skins for 15 fighters from one table, each clearly different (tested). Check: The shared OUTLINE material is skipped; cloned materials are not disposed with the rig (finding 2).

Concepts glossary

Validate at the boundary
Data from localStorage is untrusted; it is parsed and checked before it gets the Progress type, so a broken save cannot crash the game.
Nullish coalescing (??)
Takes the right side only when the left is null or undefined; here: no valid old progress means a fresh start.
Svelte derived store
A read-only store computed from other stores; here the current account's progress, recomputed whenever the accounts change.
Store contract
Any object with subscribe (and set/update for writable) works with the $store syntax, so this custom store replaces the old writable without touching components.
Shared constant
The id "custom" lives in progress.ts so hacks.ts does not import created.ts, avoiding an import cycle.
RegExp.exec
Returns the captured groups or null; the anchors ^…$ make sure the whole skin id is a look, not just part of it.
Index encoding
The type is stored as its position 0–4 in a fixed list, so the code stays short and order changes would be a breaking change.
Pydantic model validator
Runs after all fields are parsed (mode="after"), so it can check fields together: the fighter id, the skin and the name.
Compiled regex
Compiled once at import; mirrors parseLookSkin in the UI so both sides accept the same looks.
Replace with a function
String.replace with a callback fills each {name}; unknown placeholders are left as they are instead of showing "undefined".
keyof typeof
TextKey is the union of the English keys, so a typo in $t(...) or a missing translation is a type error.
Svelte 5 $state
Makes a local variable reactive; unlocked switches the template from the form to the codes.
Color.offsetHSL
Three.js shifts a colour in HSL space; one hue offset recolours a whole fighter while keeping its light and dark parts.
Material.clone
Builders may share a material between parts; cloning lets the skin change colours without touching other rigs.
Object spread
Copies the fresh start into a new object; the following keys override it, so nothing of the old progress leaks in by accident.
Shared decoder
The same function the 3D builder uses, so type and look always agree.
